Lumen Care

Protection that lasts as long as the light does.

Designed to disappear.

Every Lumen is milled from a single block of recycled aluminum, so the light is the only thing you notice. The diffuser spreads output evenly across the room, without hotspots or glare, and the dimmer responds in a fraction of a second.

Set a scene once and Lumen remembers it. Morning light is cool and bright; evening light warms gradually as the sun goes down, following your local sunset time automatically.
